subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “The printing press showed that information revolutions existed before the internet.”?
options: Every age has tools that change who can read, learn, and speak.
Every Mother's Day after that, someone asked, "Did you check the sugar"
Art may use new tools, but audiences still listen for human intention.
The best design listens to the people who use it every day.

optionRationales.reason: 本文可直接核對「The printing press showed that information revolutions existed before the internet. Every age has tools that change who can read, learn, and…」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「Every Mother's Day after that, someone asked, 'Did you check the sugar'」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Art may use new tools, but audiences still listen for human intention.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「The best design listens to the people who use it every day.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「The printing press showed that information revolutions existed before the internet. Every age has tools that change who can read, learn, and speak.」，答案為「Every age has tools that change who can read, learn, and speak.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「Every age has tools that change who can read, learn, and speak.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
